Summary: Expanded Study Session Timer header subtitle clips daily goal text ("আজ: ১৫ মি. ৫০ সে. • লক্ষ্য:...") at 360dp width
Reproduction Steps: 1. Open Home screen at 360dp width (1.0x font scale). 2. Enable/expand the Study Session Timer toggle while todayTotalSeconds > 60. 3. Observe the header subtitle below 'পড়াশোনা সেশন টাইমার'.
Expected Behavior: The full daily progress and target goal text ('আজ: ১৫ মি. ৫০ সে. • লক্ষ্য: ২৫ মি.') should be completely visible without horizontal clipping or ellipsis.
Actual Behavior: The subtitle is truncated with an ellipsis ('আজ: ১৫ মি. ৫০ সে. • লক্ষ্য:...') because the 40dp icon + title column + 52dp Switch leaves ~212dp for the single-line text.
Suspected Root Cause: Single-line Text(maxLines = 1, overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis) at line 191 combines long Bengali duration ('১৫ মি. ৫০ সে.') and verbose prefix ('দৈনিক লক্ষ্য:') in the narrow header row.
Recommended Fix: Use concise 'লক্ষ্য: ২৫ মি.' label in the expanded header subtitle so the full daily summary and goal fit on a single line at 360dp without truncation.

Summary: Study Session Timer OFF header truncates both title ('পড়াশোনা সেশন টাই...') and status ('বন্ধ • চালু করতে...') at 1.5x font scale on 360dp width
Reproduction Steps: 1. Set system font scale to 1.5x on a 360dp width viewport. 2. Open Home screen with Study Session Timer in compact OFF mode. 3. Inspect the timer card header.
Expected Behavior: At accessibility font scales (1.3x–1.5x) the card should preserve single-line readability without mid-word ellipsis on both the title and status instruction.
Actual Behavior: Both single-line texts are truncated ('পড়াশোনা সেশন টাই...' and 'বন্ধ • চালু করতে...') because maxLines = 1 is enforced while 14.sp/11.sp scale up to 21.sp/16.5.sp inside a 360dp row.
Suspected Root Cause: Hardcoded maxLines = 1 without responsive font-size clamping when LocalDensity.current.fontScale > 1.15f.
Recommended Fix: Apply a responsive headerFontScaleAdjust factor when fontScale > 1.15f so both single-line header strings fit without ellipsis at 1.5x font scale while preserving the 64..72dp compact height at 1.0x.

Summary: Expanded Study Session Timer reset button lacks visible container when disabled and daily progress summary wraps asymmetrically into 2 lines on 360dp
Reproduction Steps: 1. Open Home screen at 360dp width and expand Study Session Timer. 2. Observe the Reset IconButton next to 'শুরু' when elapsedSeconds == 0. 3. Observe the right-aligned daily session summary text.
Expected Behavior: The Reset action should have a clear outlined button container in both enabled and disabled states and the bottom progress label row should remain balanced on a single horizontal line.
Actual Behavior: The disabled Reset IconButton has no background/border (appearing as a faint floating grey icon) and 'আজ ১টি সেশন • মোট ১৫ মি. ৫০ সে.' wraps onto a second line on the right while 'দৈনিক লক্ষ্য (৬৩%)' stays on 1 line on the left.
Suspected Root Cause: IconButton at line 253 has no Surface/border container, and the progress header Row at line 289 gives equal space without compact single-line alignment.
Recommended Fix: Wrap study_timer_reset_btn in a 36dp rounded Surface with an outlineVariant border and format the progress row with single-line balanced weights.

Summary: 4-chip row inside InteractiveLearningStepCard and multi-chip topic subtype rows overflow/clip horizontally on 360dp width
Reproduction Steps: 1. Solve any problem in Math Problem Solver (LEARNING mode) on a 360dp screen. 2. Inspect the 4 FilterChips ('সহজ ব্যাখ্যা', 'কেন এই ধাপ?', 'উদাহরণ ও ভুল', 'ইঙ্গিত/চেষ্টা') inside each step card. 3. Select QUADRATIC_EQUATIONS or SIMPLE_INTEREST (COMPOUND) and inspect the non-scrollable FilterChip rows.
Expected Behavior: All FilterChip rows should either wrap cleanly via FlowRow or scroll horizontally so that the 4th/5th chip is never clipped at the right edge on 360dp screens.
Actual Behavior: InteractiveLearningStepCard (line 328) places 4 FilterChips in a plain Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) without FlowRow or horizontalScroll, causing the 4th chip ('ইঙ্গিত/চেষ্টা') to compress/clip on 360dp width; similarly QUADRATIC_EQUATIONS (line 1660), RATIO_PROPORTION (line 1260), SIMPLE_INTEREST (lines 1447, 1458) and TIME_AND_WORK (line 1509) use plain non-scrolling Rows.

Summary: 2-column Home grid cards use fixed height(200.dp * scaleFactor) with 2-line ellipsis, clipping longer module subtitles when font sizes are customized
Reproduction Steps: 1. Open Home screen in default 2-column Grid mode or increase title/subtitle font size in CustomizeScreen. 2. Inspect cards with longer Bengali titles/subtitles (e.g., 'গুণের নামতা (১–৪০)', 'সংখ্যা পদ্ধতি ও বিভাজ্যতা').
Expected Behavior: Grid cards should use heightIn(min = cardHeight) with equal-height row alignment (IntrinsicSize.Max) so cards never clip text vertically while maintaining uniform row heights.
Actual Behavior: MathModuleGridCard sets Modifier.height(cardHeight) (fixed height) and maxLines = 2 on both title and subtitle
Evidence Type: which clips longer Bengali descriptions or custom font sizes.
Recommended Fix: Fixed .height(cardHeight) at line 485 of CustomModuleRenderer.kt instead of .heightIn(min = cardHeight) combined with Row(Modifier.height(IntrinsicSize.Max)).
Final Status: Change .height(cardHeight) to .heightIn(min = cardHeight).fillMaxHeight() inside Row(Modifier.height(IntrinsicSize.Max)) so paired grid cards expand together without clipping.

Screen / Route: All 24 secondary screens without BottomNavigationBar (e.g., ProblemSolver, Quizzes, ExamArena, BookPdfViewer)
Summary: Outer Scaffold sets contentWindowInsets = WindowInsets(0, 0, 0, 0), leaving secondary screens without navigationBars bottom inset padding when the bottom navigation bar is hidden
Reproduction Steps: 1. Navigate from Home to any secondary screen where the bottom navigation bar is hidden (e.g., ProblemSolver, Quizzes, FormulaDetail, BookPdfViewer). 2. Scroll to the very bottom of the screen on an edge-to-edge device with 3-button or gesture navigation bar.
Expected Behavior: When the bottom navigation bar is hidden, the content container should apply WindowInsets.navigationBars bottom padding so bottom buttons/cards are not obscured by the system navigation bar.
Actual Behavior: MainActivity.kt line 264 sets contentWindowInsets = WindowInsets(0, 0, 0, 0). When the bottom bar is shown, NavigationBar consumes navigation bar insets; when hidden on 24 secondary screens, innerPadding.calculateBottomPadding() is 0.dp.
Suspected Root Cause: contentWindowInsets = WindowInsets(0, 0, 0, 0) on the root Scaffold suppresses system navigationBar insets whenever bottomBar emits nothing.
Recommended Fix: Apply Modifier.windowInsetsPadding(WindowInsets.navigationBars) to the inner Box in MainActivity.kt whenever showBottomNav is false.
Verification Method: MainActivity compilation + full Robolectric navigation & UI regression suite

Summary: Interactive Tutor input field label leaks the exact answer ('উত্তর লিখুন (যেমন: ${number * step})') before the user types anything
Reproduction Steps: 1. Navigate to গুণের নামতা -> ইন্টারেক্টিভ টিউটর (or open InteractiveTutor from Home). 2. Observe the prompt '৭ × ১ = ?' and inspect the OutlinedTextField label directly below it.
Expected Behavior: The input field label/placeholder should ask for the user's answer without revealing the solution to the active multiplication step.
Actual Behavior: Line 353 of BookmarksAndTutorScreens.kt sets label = { Text("উত্তর লিখুন (যেমন: ${number * step})") }, which computes and displays the exact correct answer inside the text field label for every step.
Suspected Root Cause: Developer placeholder/hint accidentally interpolated ${number * step} (the exact answer of the current question) into the OutlinedTextField label.
Recommended Fix: Change the label at line 353 of BookmarksAndTutorScreens.kt to Text('আপনার উত্তর লিখুন (বাংলা বা ইংরেজি সংখ্যায়)') without revealing number * step.
